$comment: Canonical TerraScale plan catalog. Subscription prices, allowances and overage rates approved 2026-10-23; monthly and yearly billing for every paid plan approved 2026-10-28.

subscriptions.definition: Starter, Pro and Team are each billed monthly at priceMonthlyUsd or yearly at priceAnnualUsd; a year costs ten monthly payments (two months free). billingIntervals lists the intervals a plan is sold at through checkout. Operation-unit overage is invoiced every month on both intervals.

operationUnit.name: Operation unit
operationUnit.definition: One operation unit is each started 4 KiB (4,096 bytes) of a logical object successfully read or written.
rules: Lists, queries, and batches count each item independently.
Writes count once regardless of the number of selected regions; reads count only in the serving region. Replication between regions is not billed.
Failed, denied, invalid, throttled, and not-found requests are not billed.

storage.name: Storage across regions
storage.definition: Stored bytes count once in every selected region.

allowances.definition: Free includes small allowances without a card; new writes stop at its operation allowance and there are no overage charges. Paid plans include monthly allowances; operation units over the allowance are added to the next subscription invoice at the overage rate. Storage and client egress over the allowance are not billed yet.

entitlements.name: Plan entitlements
entitlements.definition: Per-plan ceilings enforced by TerraBase. Requests per second, burst requests, and concurrent requests apply per organization; requests beyond them receive HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. queryTimeoutSeconds is the longest a single query may run. storageLimitGb is the hard storage ceiling, distinct from the included storage allowance. pitrDays is the point-in-time recovery window and backupRetentionDays the backup retention, in days. regionsPerDatabase is the number of regions a database can replicate to. support is a support response target, not an SLA. null means no plan ceiling.

egress.name: Client egress
egress.definition: Outbound application response bytes to clients, excluding replication traffic; decimal GB.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.billing: $999 per month support plus usage; contact sales.
